_comment: In-world screens: the aim assist and the sizes a screen can take (docs/design/in-world-screens.md, 'Aim assist, any size, and each screen's own settings', 2026-11-06). Read by the desktop app (src/engine/screens/tuning.rs). `aim`: the cone in degrees the nearest clickable thing on a screen is picked within (the person's own value is Settings > Controls; these are its default and its range), the hysteresis that keeps the choice from flickering (`exit_scale`: the current target is kept while it stays within the cone times this; `switch_ratio`: a rival takes over only when its angle is below the current one times this), how far inside a target the pointer lands when it snaps (`inset_px`), and how far a screen answers from: `reach_base_m`, or its diagonal times `reach_per_diagonal`, whichever is more, never past `reach_max_m`. `sizes`: the smallest and largest picture in metres (width, height), the build editor's grid step for sizes and moves, the width of the edge handles as a share of the picture's shorter side, and the presets the cog's panel offers, each a diagonal in inches and an aspect (width : height). Any number of presets may be added.
